fields.name: product_id
fields.description: SHEIN product ID (goods ID). Unique per row. The same ID is the same product in every country.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: SHEIN SKU code of this colour variant.

fields.name: spu
fields.description: SHEIN SPU code shared by all colour variants of a product.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Product title as shown to shoppers.

fields.name: product_url
fields.description: Product page on the country's SHEIN storefront.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO country code of the storefront (GB = United Kingdom).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the prices.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Selling price in local currency, as shown to shoppers (UK: incl. VAT).

fields.name: price_display
fields.description: Selling price as displayed, with currency symbol.

fields.name: original_price
fields.description: Crossed-out (reference) price in local currency.

fields.name: original_price_display
fields.description: Crossed-out price as displayed.

fields.name: discount_pct
fields.description: 1 - price / original_price, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when there is no crossed-out price above the price.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: Selling price converted to US dollars.

fields.name: top_category
fields.description: Top-level category name, e.g. Women Apparel.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Leaf category name, e.g. Women Mini Dresses.

fields.name: category_path
fields.description: Full category path from top level to leaf, separated by ' > '.

fields.name: category_id
fields.description: Leaf category ID.

fields.name: in_stock
fields.description: False when the product is shown as sold out.

fields.name: stock_indicator
fields.description: Stock as shown to shoppers: exact count below 10, 999 = 10 or more.

fields.name: review_count
fields.description: Number of reviews; 1001 means 1,000 or more.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Average star rating (1–5); empty when the product has no reviews.

fields.name: color_count
fields.description: Number of colour variants offered.

fields.name: image_url
fields.description: Main product image URL.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.description: All product image URLs (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: image_count
fields.description: Number of product images.

fields.name: seller_store_id
fields.description: ID of the seller storefront that lists the product.

fields.name: created_date
fields.description: Date the product was created.

fields.name: collected_at
fields.description: When this record was collected (UTC).
